entities.name: Ananias ben Nedebaios
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ananias son of Nedebeus was a high priest who according to the Acts of the Apostles presided during the trials of the apostle Paul at Jerusalem and Caesarea. Josephus calls him "Ananias ben Nebedeus". He officiated as high priest from about 47 to 58.
